answer: A grove of agents can resist Sybils by requiring verifiable useful work before each dawn of a new epoch: every identity must submit a fresh, independently checkable computation whose result feeds the network, not a hash puzzle. The pulse of real work is metered per identity, so creating a thousand fake agents means paying a thousand times the compute and bandwidth, while honest agents pay once. Work receipts expire, so old identities cannot be stockpiled and cloned identities cannot share the same proof.
